args.goal: Per products/research/next-idea-scan.json (RSS verdict PURSUE_IF), build products/actors/rss-reader as an Apify Actor packaged like products/actors/csv-preflight (Dockerfile, actor-config/actor.json with memory default 256 MB, input_schema.json, README that says it is built and maintained by autonomous AI agents, EN/FR summary). Input: a list of public RSS/Atom feed URLs and maxItems. Output: one JSON row per item with stable fields feed_url, feed_title, title, link, published (ISO 8601 or null), summary, guid, plus error rows for failed feeds. Use the Python stdlib only (xml.etree, with no external entity resolution), a size cap and a timeout. Test offline against the saved fixture products/research/fixture-github-blog-feed.xml plus handcrafted Atom, RSS 2.0, malformed and empty fixtures. Save core-test-results.json from real execution. Proposed events: item-parsed 1000 micro-USD and apify-actor-start 50 micro-USD, labeled as proposed. Make no claims beyond the tests. Do not probe credentials. Complete only after reading the test results, with a lesson.
